blockers.title: F1 can close on a stale self-review that predates the round-2 FAIL and ignores it
blockers.location: .milestones/manifest.json (F1 requiredReviews = self-review.json only, verificationScripts = verify); scripts/milestone.mjs:98-114; .evidence/F1/self-review.json:33,47,65,67 (mtime 2026-09-26 17:39; review-round-2.json FAIL written 18:25)
blockers.scenario: Record verification on the final tree and run milestone:complete F1. reviewPassed(self-review.json) returns true (PASS_WITH_FINDINGS, blockers []). Yet the file has no disposition of F1R-1..F1R-14. It still says SC-18 'not changed', although V05 now adds duplicate detection to the camera path. It says RR-4 'history rewritten and verified before the push', and nothing has been rewritten on the remote. It says RR-6 'a recorded first dictation made no jsDelivr request', and no such recording exists. review-round-2.json is never consulted. browser-evidence.json only has to exist and is not tied to the final source digest, because e2e is not among F1's verification scripts.
blockers.suggestedFix: Rewrite self-review.json after this round with a disposition for every F1R-* and round-3 item, making only true claims. Add the final independent review file to F1 requiredReviews. Produce browser-evidence.json from a run of the named specs (f1-navigation-guards, v05-assistant-paste) on the final digest, and record that digest in it.

blockers.title: The history rewrite and release status are written as done and verified before anything has happened; the tree contradicts itself; and nothing retires the pre-rewrite clones, so the data can be republished
blockers.scenario: `git ls-remote origin` today still shows the unrewritten main ef7cdd8, codex/0.3.0 82d1bc0, codex/post-mvp-ux-planning 8e9b2b7 and v0.2.0 bdab05d; there are no refs/pull. The tracked text states that the rewrite was done and that 'a whole-history scan of the pushed refs found none left'. A scan of pushed refs cannot precede the commit that reports it. The same docs say 'Push is done', 'completing F1 and V05', 'the four independent reviews' blockers are fixed' and 'green locally', and OPEN_ITEMS:25 says 'V05 … Complete'. None of that is true now: V05 and F1 are IN_PROGRESS, and the latest F1 review is FAIL. The tree also contradicts itself: 04_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN:291-293 still says the published refs 'still contain real student data… any history rewrite is the owner's decision', and OPEN_ITEMS:266 says the rewrite was 'deferred to a future task', against OPEN_ITEMS:32 and :117. The rewrite runs on a mirror, so this repository keeps the old objects. That includes 5 worktrees, among them Codex's .codex/worktrees/ux1-pages-promotion, plus refs/codex/turn-diffs/*. After the force-push, either agent pushing a new branch from here republishes the minors' data. So would a `git pull` that merges old and new history followed by a push, if the earliest commits are unchanged by the rewrite. Only 'anyone who cloned … should delete that clone' is mentioned, as an aside to the GitHub-cache question.
blockers.suggestedFix: Before the push: word the decision as a procedure plus evidence. For example: 'approved; rewritten on a fresh mirror immediately before the first 0.3.0 push; results in .evidence/F1/history-rewrite.json', with aggregate counts only. That file records the pre-push scan of the four rewritten refs and the tree equality between the rewritten tip and the verified tip. Record a scan of a fresh clone of the remote after the push, in a follow-up commit or at UG2. Remove 'Push is done', 'completing F1 and V05', 'blockers are fixed' and 'green locally' unless they are true at commit time, and fix 04:291-293 and OPEN_ITEMS:25 and :266. Add a mandatory post-push step: re-clone, delete every pre-rewrite clone and worktree of both agents, never push or pull-merge from them, and delete the Actions runs and artifacts of pre-rewrite commits. Then make the GitHub purge request. Push only the four named refs, never --mirror.

qolFindings.title: A staff heading that carries a date or phone no longer starts the staff section, so staff rows without a role code import as ordinary candidates
qolFindings.scenario: Probe S3: after three student rows, 'Personale al 29/08/2026' and then 'Bianchi Luca 03/04/1990' with no role code. Both become candidates, and Bianchi has no possible-staff warning. At 5c1e029 the heading started the staff section. Once the name order is set, the adult row can be ready. The owner's sheets print role codes, which still drop staff rows, so the impact is limited.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: For a personnel keyword on a line with a structured field, drop the line and mark the rows that follow possible-staff until a student heading, rather than ignoring the heading.

qolFindings.title: The F1R-6 fix turns a laid-out heading line with a date into a candidate row
qolFindings.scenario: Probe S1: 'Corso Deriva Livello … 29/08/2026' on a sheet with a table layout becomes 'Corso / Deriva Livello' with the course-start date (age 0, compound flag). It is visible noise the operator must remove.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: Require a plausible birth date (not on or after course start) or a phone, and no NON_STUDENT keyword as the first name-cell word, before this exception applies.
